_doc: Registry of the front project (front-master). A SUBSET of repo_master/repos.json (git-repos-master), narrowed to the front-* family. Identical name/url/private/doc fields to that superset; the two must not disagree. This repo is an INDEX, not a container — see clone.sh for the clone/link model.
base_dir_doc: Clones live outside this index, as siblings in $CLOUD_GIT_BASE (default ~/git). This repo holds only committed symlinks pointing at them.
_visibility_doc: private:true repos require SSH access configured for this GitHub account to clone.

repos.name: front-diegonmarcos
repos.doc: Front-end: the published site and its derive job (1_front-configs). Cloned as 'front-diegonmarcos', not after its repo name (diegonmarcos.github.io) — every front member is front-<thing>, and the bare 'front' now belongs to the project master, exactly as 'cloud' does for a_cloud.

repos.name: front-unity
repos.doc: Unity asset pipeline (unity-asset-vm: upkg2gltf, fetch-and-convert) plus its assets. Was front-asset-cdn, the predecessor of front-assets-cdn; renamed 2026-08-18 to match what it actually holds - the CDN itself is front-assets-cdn.

repos.name: front-assets-cdn
repos.doc: Front-end static assets served from the CDN.

_root_doc: No entries carry a group field — every front-* repo links at the root of this index, same as cloud-master.
